obelisk.description:
The ground vibrates beneath your feet with the unstoppable force of some unknowable reality. Before you hovers something that once was a change machine, but has now absorbed power beyond comprehension, transforming it into a 20-foot-tall metal obelisk. Its surface shudders as if the power within is barely contained, or perhaps barely containing some other force. The scent of freshly minted money subtly lingers here, even though you’ve not seen any other sign that capitalism still exists.

You can also return to [[The Streets]] or continue to [[Stadium Theater]]. You also see the [[Gift Shop]] and a building labeled [[Jersey Assignment]].

The exterior surface of the change obelisk is covered in helpful graffiti.

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: Much wisdom is collected here. You are compelled to share your own.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to link to?
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Contributions of links to slides, videos, and articles of interest.

entryway.description: You awaken suddenly beneath the ground in a dingy subway terminal. Memory floods back into you that you came here for Roguelike Celebration 2026, the grandest sports tournament in all the verse! You reach into your pocket and find your ticket for the event, which reminds you that you can click on links to travel to places like [[The Streets]], and that you can also do the same by typing '/go the streets' if you prefer.

streets.description:
You walk onto the city streets of a techno-organic utopia. Green plants cover every surface and those surfaces are brutalist slabs of bio-engineered concrete porous enough to accept and protect the roots of those plants, creating a harmonious symbiosis. The streets here orbit a massive [[Stadium Theater]], every part of this society built around attending the games held there.

Bolted onto the side of the stadium itself is a second [[Concessions Stadium]].

A short distance in front of the entrance to the stadium sits the [[Obelisk]].

To the east you see the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

And to the west you see the [[Jersey Assignment]], [[Church Of The Sacred Gamer LEDs]], and [[The Penalty Box]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: A big bulletin board, set against an unused building, reads "Social Space Feedback". An array of markers and sticky notes are nearby.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What feedback do you have about the social space itself?

jerseys.description:
You walk into a shop featuring jerseys for every popular team in the league. The walls are lined meticulously and at a glance you believe they are ordered by their rankings in the current season. The person responsible stands wearing a referee uniform and a name badge, neither of which exactly matches regulation, presumably in an attempt to keep themselves distinct.

From here, you can head to [[The Streets]], the [[Obelisk]], [[Concessions Stadium]], or [[Stadium Theater]].

The referee also holds up a bucket of face paint and offers to [[douse you->drinkPolymorph]].

The referee walks up and offers to find a jersey for you.

giftShop.description:
You enter a screaming cacophony of miscellaneous items haphazardly strewn about a room that seems to be decorated in a mid-1800s style. "Seems to be" because the surfaces are so overrun by Things that it's hard to discern any details through it all. As you look around you don’t see a single, cohesive set of anything. In fact, every single item here appears to be some kind of unique.

[[Peruse The Antiques->obeliskSouvenirs]].

While searching the shelves you notice a strange Red Bubble which seems to contain this year’s merch. Visit Red Bubble.

You can continue east to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

Or you can return to [[The Streets]] or the [[Obelisk]].

theater.description:
You step out of the concrete hallways and into the Stadium Theater. In front of you lies the field, a neatly-trimmed green space surrounded by bleachers on all sides. The scent of stale popcorn and fresh hot dogs waft through the breeze with an undercurrent of animal scent. Just as that strikes you as odd, you notice Ted The Ten Foot Armadillo resting lazily in the outfield.

You can return to [[The Streets]]. Or if you’d like to speak to one of our speakers after their talk, you can head to breakout rooms: [[The Dugout]], [[Press Box]], [[VIP Seats]], [[Waterboy Lounge]].

(Check the 'Happening Now!' button on the left for speaker room assignments!) Pop Out Stream. Pop Out Live Captions.

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: There is a whiteboard set up to the side with "SPEAKER QUESTIONS" written at the top. "Questions for speakers not questions from speakers!" is hastily scrawled below it.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to ask?
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Questions for the current speaker, ranked by upvotes.

unconferencingHub.description:
You step onto a large, featureless slab. The ground here is black rubber painted with yellow lines demarking some kind of territory or perhaps organizational rule. Streetlamps rise on poles and cast over the area a dim, reddish glow that is easy on the eyes. It strikes you as odd that such a large space has been cleared for nothing of value, but you suppose it must serve a ritual purpose of some kind.

To the north you see the [[Irrepressible Feelings Zone]]. To the east you see [[Scalper's Alley->unconfScalpers]] and the [[Practice Fields]]. Just south of that is the [[Tailgaters' Union Office->unconfTailgate]].

Or you can return to [[The Streets]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: At the corner of the parking lot, a sports fanatic holds up a giant foam finger and a sign that reads "UNCONFERENCE TOPIC SUGGESTIONS! Write what you want to chat with others about, and upvote topics you find interesting. Five minutes into each uncoferencing block, moderators will assign the top four topics to rooms. Have fun!"
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to suggest?
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Topics for unconferencing discussion, ranked by upvotes.

unconfFeelings.description:
You step into what looks like the blasted remains of a parking lot. Overturned cars smolder in the distance and large men with colorfully-painted skin scream at one another, arguing over which player was the MVP of the most recent game. Each of these men appears to be quietly followed by another person wearing a soft cardigan and holding a notebook. As the colorful men throw and break things, the cardigan-clad person asks them questions in a soft voice. There appears to be a consistent flow of movement where the men will churn through the back parking lot, flipping cars or tearing down infrastructure until such time as their assigned cardigan brings them inexorably towards the exit and back into society.

One man does not follow this pattern of movement. Instead he stands still, raving about a temple hidden in the trees.

Or you could walk back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfScalpers.description:
You walk into a dark alleyway visibly decorated with a theatrical approximation of an ancient city street in need of cleaning services. Cartoonish piles of "trash" sit artfully against garbage bins that have been artificially weathered to appear old and worn. Actors stand in costume, offering you tickets for extreme discounts (even though the real tickets are, of course, free). There's even a fire that's been lit as if to give the impression of danger, but you're pretty sure you can see a fire marshall's badge under the worn out rags of a nearby vagrant.

Or you can head back to [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfPractice.description:
You step onto a wide open field full of people running about and performing various feats of athletic prowess. Each player appears to be practicing for something wildly different from every other player present in this space. Standing among the chaos is a referee who holds a massive tome gilt with gold. He offers you a reading of the holy rules [Calvin Ball Rule Generator].

Or you can head back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfTailgate.description:
You step into an immaculately cleaned office building dedicated to tailgating, including an active grill where a young woman in a business suit is handing out hot dogs. Most of the occupants of this building sit behind desks taking calls or filing paperwork, but a small staff is dedicated to ensuring that guests have a perfect tailgating experience. There is also a desk dedicated to anyone running their own tailgate services in any of the nearby parking areas. You see pamphlets offering health & safety advice, worker's union standards, and tips for maximizing the positive social impact of your tailgate.

Or you can head back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

concessions.description:
You walk into an ostentatious foyer adorned with gilding on every surface. The hallway is lined with a literal red carpet which splits to direct visitors towards the restaurants on offer here.

To the left you see the [[Soda Fountain]].

Straight ahead leads into [[Orville's]].

Turning to the right the hall leads to [[Chez Nathan's]].

Or you can head back to [[The Streets]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: You see a book penned by those who create such things. "Procedural Generation Surprises" is written on the cover and there are some pens nearby for you to add your own stories.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: Tell us of a time a procedural generator has surprised or delighted you!
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Tales of strange, delightful emergent results from procedural generators.

chezNathan.description:
Stepping into Chez Nathan’s is like stepping into a gold-encrusted shrine to the exuberant joy of childhood flavor palettes. The decor here is whimsical and made to be climbed on or sprinted around, but it’s all scaled for full adults and finely accented. The air here smells of meat and oil with an undercurrent so unhinged you couldn’t begin to guess at what other flavors these hot dogs must be offered in. Looking at the menu confirms your concerns as the largest text visible reads "Just ask, we serve it".

You can have them make you a hot dog.

Or you can head back to the [[Concessions Stadium]].

orville.description:
You enter a space full of the raucous sound of thousands of tiny explosions happening at once. Each wall here is made of glass and within that glass is a towering wall of popped corn. You watch as mechanisms move each section of wall’s product through a series of elaborate stations that sift the dry seeds, heat them until they pop, and then dip them in liquids ranging from butter to caramel, from chocolate to mysterious liquids you can’t discern. The resulting snack arrives at a station set aside for that particular flavor, people wearing striped red and white uniforms handing out similarly-colored paper boxes filled with the treat.

You can ask the counter for some [[popcorn->popcorn]].

Or you can head back to the [[Concessions Stadium]].

sodaFountain.description:
A towering fountain looms over a bar attended by people dressed in an ancient clothing style from the 1950s, including brightly covered overalls and foppish hats. Each nozzle of the fountain is a different color and the smell of sugar wafts through the air as the fountain’s colorful attendants hold out curved glasses filled with carbonated fluid of various flavor.

You can have them dispense a drink for you.

There's also a strange lever nearby. You have the urge to [[pull it->wheatField]].

Or you can return to the [[Concessions Stadium]].

churchOfGamers.displayName: Church of the Sacred Gamer LEDs
churchOfGamers.description:
You step into a cathedral with high ceilings and filled with the scent of musky incense. Brightly-colored fans spin beneath stained glass windows depicting images of people of every variety sitting in front of computers of every style and size. A robed priest stands behind an altar, cleaning his hands in sanctified Mountain Dew, offering a blessed Dorito to each faithful.

A small room to the right of the central altar is attended by priests holding strips of LEDs. They stand behind an altar marked "Steam Sale" and urge you to approach. Visit the Steam Sale!

From here you can walk south to [[The Penalty Box]].

To the east you can head to [[Jersey Assignment]].

To the north you could reach the [[Concessions Stadium]].

penaltyBox.description:
You’re encased in a small room of darkened, unbreakable plexiglass that muddies the sounds of celebration around you. Strips of neon lighting glimmer along the walls, giving an ethereal feeling to the otherwise normal bar. Looking up you see the current time shown in an old LCD panel, the red-segmented display indicating that the next match is nearly ready to begin. A dour jelly with a set of wispy mutton chops glares at you from behind the bar, waiting for you to make a selection. Behind the jelly, three goats stare ominously into your soul. A nearby whiteboard lists out the choices: [Tap Water], [Sparkling Water], [Beer of Indeterminate Origin™], [Pan-Galactic Gargle Blaster].

If you're not thirsty you can always return to [[The Streets]].

dugout.description:
You step onto a patch of earth that has been completely overgrown by sunflowers. Behind the stalks you see the eyes of disgruntled players doing their best to watch the game from behind the overgrowth. As you watch, one player spits a sunflower seed into the nearby dirt and you gain an understanding of the cycle of life happening here. Nearby, more intrepid players spend their downtime cultivating the sunflowers, harvesting and drying their seeds for future snacking.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

pressbox.description:
You find yourself standing beneath a massive tower reaching far into the heavens. Lining that tower are reporters calling out raucously, describing the game to viewers all over the earth. Each person on the tower is speaking in their native tongue, ensuring the ability for as many viewers as possible to enjoy this great and holy pastime. You gaze in awe at the massive tower, wondering at the strength of man to build such a thing.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

vipSeats.description:
You enter a room made with gold walls etched with a bas-relief depicting the great moments in sports history. Each seat is a plush throne and a massive table fills one entire wall with plates full of piles of decadent fruit, nuts, sliced meat, and cheese. The air here is chilled to a perfect level of comfort and massive TV screens fill the wall so that no matter where your head may turn, the game will never be out of your sights.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

waterboy.description:
You walk into a room styled after victorian decor with a wood floor and patterned wallpaper, all of which looks rather dingy and old in a way that makes it all feel somehow more refined. On one side of this room stands a large tank of crystalline water that is occupied by an alarmingly handsome fish man. A sign labels this tank as "The Water Boy" and you see a stack of large orange coolers being filled with this crystalline water, but only after visual approval from the fish man, who gives an uncomfortably sultry wink when the water passes his quality requirements.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

templeOfPlay.description:
You enter a quiet church decorated with massive stone pillars strung together with ropes and nets, its floor cushioned to prevent harm. The quiet here is punctuated with the sound of vibrant laughter. This space is visibly sacred but so are these joyful utterances. Worshippers do not sit in long wooden benches, but dangle from hanging ropes or swing from the rafters. A robed man wearing a miter hat gleefully blesses people with holy water balloons.

A goat stands atop the sacred bouncy castle, glaring at you.

ballPit.description:
You enter a realm that appears to be mostly balls of every shape and size. You stand upon a black strip of obsidian stone beneath a black sky with a black sun glowing ethereally. The world here appears to be in a neutral state for now, awaiting to transform upon activation. Beneath you is an endless ocean of spheres with every size, shape, and texture imaginable. Baseballs, basketballs, balls made of spiders, lightning, or even love.

A nozzel sticks up from the pit, labelled Random Ball Generator. You may reach into it and [[claim one for yourself->randomBallGenerator]].

Or you can return to the [[Practice Field]]

capitalism.description: You enter a universe that reeks of the smell of freshly printed dollar bills. Middle aged men in sloppy t-shirts and pressed business suits stand beneath every shady tree or sit atop every cushion. Many of these men are hoarding comfortable surfaces beyond what they could possibly use for themselves, apparently just to deny comfort to others. You follow the sound of clanking metal and find an unfathomably large pile of metal coins. Men in business suits dive into the coins from a diving board as if the coins were some kind of swimming pool. Their bodies break against the unfeeling gold.

wheatField.description:
You pull the lever on the soda fountain and suddenly appear in a wheat field. The field stretches equal distances in all 4 directions, it appears to be a perfectly square patch. Soldiers march through this field on their way to fight off forces of centaurs, harpies, and other hostile forces. A burnt smell wafts through the air and you fear if you stick around too long a dragon may appear.

A goat stands at one side of the field, watching your every move. Unblinkingly.

You don't see a way back to the soda fountain, but to the south you see [[The Castle]].

castle.description:
Suddenly you find yourself at the entrance gates to a fae castle. Crenelated stone walls rise high above you with towers at each corner of the massive fortification. Surrounding the castle are patchwork squares of wheat fields, forests, mountains, and lakes. This patchwork ocassionally shifts as if the hand of god were playing a match 3 game with them.

In front of you is the gate itself. A man in casual clothes stands before it holding a STOP sign. You are compelled by the sign, and some strange magic, unable to proceed. The man tells you that the only way past this point is to invoke the opposite of what he is holding.

sign.description:
You enter a richly-appointed bed chamber of what could not be anything other than the queen of this court. All around the room lie sconces lit with too-bright flames, giving the entire space an oppressive heat. At the far wall, you see a woman with strong, regal bearing leaning casually over the balcony, smoking a cigarette.

The woman leans over to you, blows out a puff of smoke, and says "What? You want out? Or deeper? The goats run the toll booth. First three letters of each of their rooms will bring you to their place. Maybe you'll have better luck convincing them. No promises, though, you might just get souveniers like I did... At least the baseball is good around here..."

whetempen.description:
Having spoken the password, you appear in a cramped studio apartment in the inner city. Standing in front of you is a goat wearing a blue baseball cap and designer shades. He bleats at you "Whoa! Not cool to just barge in, I'm off the clock, bro."

Despite his protests, he doesn't immediately kick you out.

A nearby table is marked "Souvenirs" and contains several objects. You see [[Admission Ticket to Delaware->item]], [[Potion of Liking Baseball->item]], and [[Fae Court's Tax Form->item]].

Or you can head back to [[The Streets]].

transcendence.description:
You step into a Transcendence-branded battle arena built by this year's sponsor! In the center of a grand arena are massive holoprojectors recreating a fierce battle happening somewhere far overhead as gladiators in starships duke it out to prove who is the strongest.

A gift shop sits near the entrance offering a Transcendence Foam Finger, a Trascendence Stuffed Starship, or you could reach into the bucket and pull out a random item from the game!

On the side of the gift shop is a table with copies of the game. Grab The Game!
